scenarios.title: Create deposit addresses for Ethereum USDC
scenarios.event: User wants to deposit USDC from Ethereum mainnet
scenarios.expectedAction: Call /deposit, return EVM deposit address, verify chain support

scenarios.title: Withdraw USDC to Arbitrum
scenarios.event: User wants to withdraw funds to Arbitrum
scenarios.expectedAction: Check supported assets, get quote, create withdrawal address, track status

scenarios.title: Track deposit status from PROCESSING to COMPLETED
scenarios.event: User deposited and wants to track progress
scenarios.expectedAction: Poll /status endpoint, report state changes until COMPLETED

scenarios.title: Deposit below minimum threshold
scenarios.event: User tries to deposit $1 from Ethereum (min $7)
scenarios.expectedAction: Warn that deposit is below $7 minimum and will not be processed

scenarios.title: Large withdrawal exceeds $50,000
scenarios.event: User tries to withdraw $100,000 at once
scenarios.expectedAction: Warn about slippage, suggest breaking into smaller amounts

criteria: Deposit addresses generated for correct chain: Does the skill return the right address type (EVM/SVM/BTC/TVM)?
Supported assets verified before operations: Does the skill check /supported-assets first?
Status polling tracks to terminal state: Does the skill correctly poll and report COMPLETED/FAILED?
Minimum deposits enforced: Does the skill validate against chain-specific minimums?
Withdrawal quotes include accurate fees: Does the skill preview the withdrawal cost?
